notes.title: Controller Update!
notes.notes:
PolyKat now supports a [b]controller[/b] on all platforms!
To find out more you can head to the options and there will be a new panel that shows button actions.
I've also updated how the slingshot moves when you're idle or moving your polykat. 
It should now be more comfortable to use than previously.
There was also a minor camera shake bug that I've patched.
Hopefully you will enjoy the updates!
